from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquity(BaseModel):
    """One company's equity figure from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the financial report")
    equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="归属于母公司股东权益 (equity attributable to shareholders of parent company)")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency/unit of the equity amount, e.g. 'CNY'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024 Q1'")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code of the company if available")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the equity amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_reports: list[CompanyEquity]
